instruction: boltons.tableutils.Table.to_text() crashes on degenerate tables: Table([[]]).to_text() raises ValueError (it should return ''); None or other non-string header values raise AttributeError (they should render the same way as data cells, so a None header shows as 'None'); and a table with fewer headers than columns raises IndexError (short header rows should be padded with None to the table width, as to_html does). When there are no headers, to_text() should render no header row and no separator line at all (Table([[], [1]]).to_text() == '1'), matching to_html. Add tests.
